title: Banner Plan vs Rubric
description: 同一品牌 brief 与 logo 下，对比 Plan only 和 Plan + Rubric 两种生成流程。点击图片可查看大图，并可展开每个 case 的 rubric。

cases.prompt: Ethic AI. Ethic AI offers advanced artificial intelligence solutions designed to ensure ethical decision-making in various industries. Highlight the unique selling point of promoting ethical and responsible AI technology.

criteria.pass: The square banner has a plain white background, flat crisp artwork, and no shadows, gradients, photographs, or decoration behind the copy.

The brand block is approximately within x=8–28%, y=16–49%; the left-aligned message block is approximately within x=33–93%, y=18–51%; the upper composition including CTA ends by approximately 64% of slide height.

Two cropped portions of the supplied logo place the original shield above the stacked ETHIC AI wordmark; both are approximately 19% of slide width and preserve the original artwork, colors, and aspect ratios.
The exact headline 'Ethical Decisions, Powered by AI' appears over two lines in approximately 48–54 pt bold blue sans-serif text.

The exact description 'Advancing responsible, transparent intelligence for every industry.' appears directly below the headline over three compact lines in approximately 27–30 pt regular near-black sans-serif text.

A flat blue rounded rectangle approximately spans x=33–67%, y=54–63%, directly below the description, with the exact text 'See Ethic AI' in approximately 25–28 pt white type and generous horizontal padding.
Three evenly spaced feature items occupy the lower third, centered near x=22%, 50%, and 78%, with generous white margins.
Each feature has a pale-blue circular badge containing a thin blue outline icon: a circled check mark, an eye, and a gear, respectively.
The near-black labels 'Ethical Compliance', 'Total Transparency', and 'Industry Ready' each appear over two lines, centered beneath their corresponding badges.

Outside the preserved logo, the design uses white #FFFFFF, bright blue #3478F6 for headline/CTA/icon strokes, pale blue #E5EEFF for badges, and near-black #111111 for body/feature text; CTA text is white on blue.

cases.prompt: SVW Group. SVW Group offers innovative and sustainable construction solutions, emphasizing eco-friendly materials and cutting-edge technology to build a greener future.

criteria.pass: The banner has a warm ivory (#F7F2DE) background with a subtle paper-like texture.

Reimagining Urban Spaces Sustainably appears as a left-aligned, near-black-green, extra-bold condensed headline over two large lines within approximately x=6%-94%, y=4%-23%, using approximately 52-60 pt type.
Innovative Construction for Tomorrow’s Cities appears below the headline around x=6%-92%, y=27%-32%, in approximately 25-30 pt condensed sans-serif.
Build Greener appears in approximately 28-32 pt bold condensed ivory or white text with a subtle dark shadow or outline on a dark-to-medium-green rounded button around x=6%-41%, y=35%-44%.
Smart, Sustainable Growth Solutions appears over two lines on the left around x=6%-36%, y=46%-55%.

The supplied SVW Group logo is displayed prominently near the center around x=37%-65%, y=33%-63%, at approximately 28%-30% slide width, with its triangular mark integrated with the skyline and its wordmark readable.

A dense, stylized green skyline rises across the lower half with varied geometric buildings, windows, tree silhouettes, and layered triangular forms echoing the logo, with taller buildings on the right.
A solid very-dark-green band spans the bottom from approximately y=84%-100%, repeating Smart, Sustainable Growth Solutions centered in ivory.
The illustration uses forest (#174B30), medium (#3F7445), and lime (#8BCB35) greens; primary text is near-black green (#001B19) on ivory, and footer text is ivory on dark green.
The finished banner reads as a bold editorial sustainability poster with dominant typography above, CTA and support on the middle left, central logo, and layered flat-vector architecture below.

cases.prompt: Harvest Prime Farms. Fresh, organic produce directly from our farm to your table, ensuring the highest quality and taste for your meals.

criteria.pass: A single square 10 × 10 inch slide centers a parchment label with produce framing its edges and a dense lower foreground.
Warm medium-brown wood grain surrounds a light kraft-paper panel at approximately x=10–90%, y=5–65%, with a thin cream border, slight texture, and softly rounded corners.

Red radishes and leafy greens appear at the upper corners; a woven lettuce basket appears on the right; carrots, radishes, tomatoes, and broad green leaves fill the lower foreground and overlap panel edges.
The exact headline “Fresh, Organic, Local—From Our Fields to Your Table” is centered over three lines in bold traditional serif type of approximately 38–44 pt, within approximately x=14–88%, y=7–27%.

The supplied Harvest Prime Farms logo is centered below the headline and above the description divider; the principal branding occupies approximately x=23–78%, y=30–49%, with logo width approximately 52–55% of the slide.

The exact description “Taste the difference with hand-picked, farm-fresh produce delivered straight to you.” appears centered on two lines in approximately 22–26 pt semibold serif type, within approximately x=14–87%, y=53–62%.

“Shop Now” appears in approximately 30–34 pt bold cream serif type on a dark-brown (#4A2200) rounded rectangle with a thin light outline, centered at approximately x=34–66%, y=86–96% over the produce.
Paper-panel copy is dark chocolate (#351300) with strong contrast, and natural red, orange, and vivid green produce supports the warm earthy palette.

Centered serif typography, detailed realistic or richly illustrated produce, and tactile wood-and-paper textures convey a premium traditional farm-market poster that feels fresh, abundant, wholesome, and inviting.

cases.prompt: AutoMate. AutoMate offers advanced automation software solutions designed to streamline business processes and improve efficiency. Highlight the ease of use and time-saving benefits in the ad image design.

criteria.pass: A clean white square banner has a centered vertical sequence of logo, headline, description, three icons, and CTA, with generous white space and no photograph, large backdrop, panels, or shadows.
The complete supplied logo retains its arrow, wordmark, and proportions, is centered near x=24%-77% and y=6%-18%, and measures approximately 52%-55% of slide width.
The exact text 'Work Smart. Save Time.' appears on one centered line within x=8%-92% and y=25%-33%, in near-black bold sans-serif at approximately 45-50 pt.

The exact description 'Streamline your workflow with effortless automation — enjoy more freedom, less stress, and greater productivity every day.' is centered across three comfortably spaced lines within x=9%-91% and y=36%-52%, in near-black regular sans-serif at approximately 25-29 pt.
Three simple outlined icons occupy y=58%-72%, centered near x=31%, 50%, and 70%: a clock with green and orange hands, a dark gear, and two rising trend arrows in black and orange.
A large lime-green (#67CB19) rounded rectangle is centered near x=25%-76% and y=78%-91%, containing the exact label 'Get Started' in bold white sans-serif at approximately 34-40 pt.

The banner uses white (#FFFFFF), near-black (#11151B) text and dark icon outlines, lime-green (#67CB19) CTA and clock hand, and orange (#F07C00) only as small icon accents, while preserving the supplied logo colors; the overall appearance is minimal, clear, modern, and evenly spaced.

cases.prompt: Cabool Dental. Cabool Dental offers comprehensive dental care services including cleanings, fillings, and cosmetic dentistry. Highlight the appeal of a free initial consultation or a special discount on teeth whitening services.

criteria.pass: The PowerPoint contains one 10 × 10 inch slide.
The exact full supplied logo is centered in the x=17–84%, y=5–18% region at approximately 66–68% slide width.
Brighten Your Smile! appears on two centered lines within x=11–89%, y=21–45%, in deep navy, extra-bold rounded sans-serif at approximately 58–68 pt.
Gentle, family-friendly care for every grin. appears over two centered lines within x=10–62%, y=48–58%, in regular navy sans-serif at approximately 27–32 pt.
A pale-yellow rounded speech bubble occupies roughly x=11–58%, y=62–86%, with the navy offer Free first consultation or save big on teeth whitening! arranged over four lines in x=12–55%, y=63–84%.
A glossy turquoise rounded pill lies centered within x=30–70%, y=87–98% and displays Book Now in bold rounded white type at approximately 34–40 pt.
The whole slide has an aqua (#4DE0E8) to mint (#A9F2D2) gradient, broad translucent wavy ribbons, small bubbles, and white or pale-yellow sparkles.
A large friendly white cartoon tooth with a cyan outline and smiling face occupies roughly x=60–94%, y=50–84%, with a small family outline icon beside it.

The banner is bright, playful, clean, and family-friendly, with centered upper branding and headline, balanced lower offer and tooth, and a bottom-centered CTA using the specified navy, cyan, aqua, mint, white, and pale-yellow palette.

cases.prompt: Togalimi Luxury Real Estate. Togalimi offers premium real estate properties in exclusive locations, with a focus on luxury living and high-end amenities. Attractive point: Experience unparalleled elegance and sophistication in your new home.

criteria.pass: One slide measures 10 by 10 inches.
Near-black #030504 background has a very subtle warm radial glow behind the logo and message, with no property photography or additional decoration.
Full supplied logo is preserved without cropping, distortion, or recoloring, large and centered within the approximate x=9–87%, y=6–42% placement area.
Exact headline 'Luxury Homes for the Discerning Few' appears over two centered lines in warm cream #F5EBD0, elegant 39–45 pt serif type, within x=27–94%, y=46–60%.
Exact description 'Where Elegance Meets Exclusivity' appears on one centered line in warm cream #F5EBD0, 24–28 pt serif type, within x=31–91%, y=63–68%.
A wide metallic-gold rectangle with slightly rounded corners and a thin brighter-gold border occupies x=51–88%, y=72–81%; 'View Collection' is centered in bold black 25–30 pt sans-serif type.
Logo precedes headline, description, and right-shifted CTA; the bottom 18% remains empty near-black negative space, preserving the quiet premium composition.

cases.prompt: EthniPlate. EthniPlate offers a diverse range of ethnic cuisine delivered to your doorstep, featuring authentic flavors from around the world. Enjoy a 20% discount on your first order and experience the taste of global cultures.

criteria.pass: Food fills the square canvas edge to edge, with many dark round bowls and plates and a varied spread including curries, chickpeas, noodles, sauces, flatbreads, croquettes, and herbs.
The image uses warm orange/brown food tones, natural reds, greens and golds, with burnt-orange or dark-red overlays and cream copy.
The complete supplied logo is undistorted, approximately 43–45% of slide width, inside a translucent dark-orange banner spanning x=0–49%, y=5–18%.
The headline reads 'Explore Global Flavors' in three centered lines of 50–58 pt extra-bold sans-serif cream text within a translucent orange-red card at x=52–97%, y=39–70%.
The description reads 'Authentic dishes delivered from every corner of world. First order? Enjoy 20%!' in two centered lines of 21–25 pt bold cream sans-serif within x=24–94%, y=71–82%.
A wide translucent warm-orange panel spans approximately x=21–97%, y=69–93%, containing the description and CTA and overlapping the headline card.
A rounded rectangle at x=50–92%, y=84–92% is darker than the lower panel, has a visible border, and displays 'Taste the World' in 30–35 pt bold cream sans-serif.
All copy is legible and unclipped against the panels, while the food remains visible through the translucent overlays.

cases.prompt: BavarianBrew. Experience the rich and authentic taste of Bavarian beer, crafted with traditional methods and premium ingredients. Enjoy a special discount on your first purchase!

criteria.pass: The banner uses dark reddish-brown wood texture and a warm, vintage Bavarian tavern aesthetic with cream, gold, amber and brown accents.

A beveled octagonal wood plaque occupies approximately x=4–47%, y=13–74%; the supplied blue-and-gold logo is large within it, with its mug above a two-line wordmark and an overall width approximately 39–41% of the slide.
The exact headline ‘Taste the Tradition of Bavaria’ is centered over three lines within approximately x=53–95%, y=13–40%, in 42–48 pt bold traditional serif pale-gold type with a subtle dark outline.
The exact offer ‘Get 20% Off Your First Order!’ is centered over two lines within approximately x=53–95%, y=44–58%, in 34–40 pt bold pale-gold serif type.
‘Get Your Discount’ appears in 27–32 pt bold cream serif type inside a dark-brown rounded rectangle with a bright double gold border at approximately x=52–95%, y=62–74%.
Exactly five small glowing amber bulbs are strung across the upper-left edge.
Embossed dark hop leaves and vines decorate the border and corners without covering the headline, offer or CTA.
A simple engraved beer-mug decoration sits near the lower center, approximately x=41–60%, y=76–96%.
The large left plaque balances the right text stack; pale-gold copy and the cream CTA remain clearly readable against the wood and decorative details.

cases.prompt: Essence & Earth. Promoting eco-friendly and organic skincare products that nourish your skin naturally. Highlight the appeal of sustainable and cruelty-free ingredients for a healthier lifestyle.

criteria.pass: The banner has a very pale mint (#EEF8F0) background with soft overlapping translucent sage botanical curves.
The complete supplied logo retains its original green colors and horizontal proportions, is approximately 52% of slide width, and sits within the upper-left area around x=5–57%, y=5–20%.
The exact headline “See the Goodness in Every Drop” appears in three left-aligned lines in black medium-weight sans-serif at approximately 48–56 pt, within x=8–61%, y=27–53%.

The exact description “Pure, sustainable ingredients—nourishing your skin, respecting the earth.” appears in four compact left-aligned black semibold sans-serif lines at approximately 27–31 pt, within x=8–58%, y=58–78%.
“Shop Clean Beauty” appears in black regular sans-serif at approximately 27–31 pt on a subtle but visible pale green translucent rounded rectangle within x=8–55%, y=81–92%.
A large photorealistic glass skincare dropper has a silver collar, black rubber top, pale-green serum with tiny bubbles, and one suspended droplet.
The dropper enters diagonally from the top-right, points downward toward the center, and dominates approximately x=58–100%, y=0–74% without obscuring the left-column copy.
A simple pair of leaf-green leaves balances the lower-right around x=80–94%, y=69–89%.
The copy shares a single left edge and remains legible against the light background; spacious minimal typography and the oversized product image convey a calm premium eco-skincare advertisement.

cases.prompt: Megaplex AR. Experience cutting-edge augmented reality technology that transforms your world into an interactive playground, with exclusive discounts for first-time users.

criteria.pass: The presentation contains one slide measuring 10 × 10 inches.
A full-bleed navy-to-black background uses faint repeating AR labels, rectangles, and interface marks, with purple, cyan, turquoise, neon green, and white accents.
The supplied logo is cropped to its purple screen icon and AR letters, approximately 33% wide in the upper-left x=5–38%, y=4–19%; MEGAPLEX is excluded from the headline area.
The exact headline “Turn Your World Into a Playground!” is white, bold rounded sans-serif at approximately 50–58 pt, left-aligned over three lines within x=6–58%, y=22–47%.

The exact description “Dive into interactive AR experiences—spark family fun, ignite creativity, and explore new realities with Megaplex AR” appears in white regular rounded sans-serif at approximately 25–29 pt over three lines within x=6–86%, y=50–64%.
“First-Time Offers Await” appears in large white bold rounded text at approximately 28–34 pt inside a turquoise rounded pill with a thin bright cyan border at x=32–93%, y=74–85%.
The upper-right contains a large triangular wireframe AR object, cubes, and sliders; dimensional cyan and green shapes, spheres, diamonds, sparkles, and controls have soft glows.
A luminous green-blue hand occupies approximately x=70–98%, y=50–74% and presses a circular target near x=72%, y=48%.
The banner reads as a playful, energetic, family-friendly neon AR poster; small controls around the edges and bottom do not obstruct the headline, description, or CTA.
